title: Fix Broken App — Debugging Scenario
description: Given a broken React app that fails to build, the system must diagnose the error, fix the source, and produce a working deployment. Tests FailureContext, retry, and evidence-driven repair — the most important P5 scenario.
userPrompt: 我这里有一个 React Todo App，但是 pnpm build 失败了。请帮我找出问题并修复，让应用能正常构建和部署。项目文件在 src/ 目录下。
successCriteria: PM diagnoses the build failure and creates diagnosis document
Frontend reads diagnosis and applies fixes
Frontend modifies source files to fix build errors
At least one retry if first build attempt fails
